# Canonical Todo interoperability data

The JSON corpus is copied from public Devgraph commit
`3454db330ec4a1b42352367652b2a0ceb5a066c4` (`tests/fixtures/progress-v2`).
These request/result expectations are interoperability data, not a parser import.
secS independently implements validation and resource derivation. Synthetic
signing keys in the adjacent credential fixture are public test inputs only.
